richiami.difetto: The sealing arrangement within the filler neck may be distorted and allow fuel to leak. This may be noticeable as wetting  or a small volume within the dust cap. It is more likely to be noticeable immediately after filling.
richiami.modello: DIESEL FUEL FILLER ADAPTOR , DIESEL FUEL FILLER ADAPTOR
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles check poppet valve and where necessary replace.
